snippet.title: Desktop Island: Idle Together! - Announcement Trailer
snippet.description:
Wishlist now: https://store.steampowered.com/app/4275000/Desktop_Island_Idle_Together/

Desktop Island is a co-op life sim to be enjoyed through both an active or idle playstyle. Play solo, or with up to 5 friends to restore your island and create a communal hub. Meet the inhabitants, choose your profession, master deep progression, and gather resources to build your dream island.
